name: claude-orchestrator
description: Desktop app that orchestrates the Claude CLI across many projects/tasks â€” runs one session per task, auto-respawns when usage limits reset, advances through a plan.md, and surfaces Claude's questions in a dashboard.

scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:node && npm run typecheck:web
scripts.package: electron-vite build && electron-builder install-app-deps && npm run ensure:abi && electron-builder --win --publish onTagOrDraft && npm run check:feed
